0022600122.text: The Dallas Mavericks visit the Miami Heat in their fourth game of the season, with Dallas at 1-2 and 12th in the West, while Miami is 0-3, on a three-game losing streak, and 15th in the East. Dallas is missing six players: Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Naji Marshall (illness), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met in the 2026-27 season, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Mavericks winning the most recent meeting 118-108 in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
